rows.en: Everyone, I know how you feel, but you should return to base and recover first.
The next fight will be the true showdown. Rushing in blindly plays right into the enemy's hands.
It was only for an instant, but I picked up quantum brainwaves...
It's a kind of telepathy that Innovators give off... I sensed it faintly.
Our movements may have been detected.
You mean that Reborns Gundam guy?
...No, I can't tell... Who on earth was it?
It was only for an instant, but I picked up quantum brainwaves...
Our movements may have been detected.
...No, I can't tell... Who on earth was it?
We're on the lower level. The reactor core is close...
What're you doing!! Get to the Libra Cannon control room and stop it from firing already!!
Epyon has gone after you!! Please be careful!!
You idiot!! What the hell did you come back for!!
So this is the Monster Graveyard...!!
Seravee, do you know about it too?
Seravee, do you know about it too?
Seravee, you know about this place too?
Seravee, you know about it as well!?
Seravee, you know this place too?
No. The information was in Veda.
If we can make use of Veda, we'll have the advantage in battle.
Yes. Veda doesn't have everything, but I'll support you as best I can.
I see. I'm counting on you.
I see. I'm counting on you.
No, that's plenty. Seravee, I'm counting on you.
That's reassuring!! Seravee, I'm counting on you!
Now that's reassuring! Seravee, I'm counting on ya!
It appears to be the Monster Graveyard.
It's a place in the Ultras' world, where monsters, aliens and the like are laid to rest.
You sure know a lot about it, huh?
No, I didn't know about it myself, but the information was in Veda.
Veda doesn't have everything, but I'll support you as best I can.

notes.note: 0.211-0.220: party-leader variant block reacting to Seravee's voice; 0.215 is the polite (-san) variant, honorific dropped per style, so identical English.
Seravee speaks through Veda (consciousness linked with Veda, story_140). 'you should return to base' keeps Seravee outside the group.
Ankh stumbles on the first word of the Japanese term (brain...); English order puts 'quantum' first, so he trips on that. Same for 0670.19 (stray duplicate after the 00 variant).
Japanese term here is the 00 'brain quantum waves'; rendered with the established 'quantum brainwaves'.
'reactor core' = core of Libra (lowercase, not the Ride Machine item).
Sandrock warns the party heading to the Libra Cannon control room that Epyon followed them; 'you' = the party (inferred).
Birth blocks Gaddess. Avoided 'Not so fast!!' because that is Arche Gundam's fixed catchphrase.

Speaker labels in 0701 look misassigned: 'Seravee's Voice' sits on party-leader lines (0.12, 0.18, 0.20, 0.30, 0.32, 0.34) and 'Ankh' on Seravee's lines (0.19, 0.29, 0.31, 0.33 uses Tieria's 'boku', 0.35). Translated by content: Seravee (via Veda) explains; leader asks.
Speaker unclear (labelled Seravee's Voice, but content is a party member reacting). Kept neutral 'we'.
0.20-0.24 leader variants of 'I'm counting on you' (speaker asks Seravee). 0.22 'No, that's plenty' answers 'Veda doesn't have everything'.
0.1-0.10 paired leader variants; 0.11 a single-line variant.

report: 80/80 rows. 0701 speaker labels appear misassigned (Seravee's Voice vs Ankh); translated by content. 0670.4/0.19 wordplay adapted. No new names.
